blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — A 55-year-old truck driver died while two others were injured after his vehicle crashed into a roadside tree in Mulanay town, Quezon province, on Wednesday evening, police said. The truck was descending the road in Barangay Butanyog at around 7:30 p.m. when its brakes reportedly failed, Quezon police reported. READ: Toddler, 2 others dead in Quezon road accidents Police said the driver deliberately steered the truck into a tree to stop the vehicle. The driver was dead at the scene.
